featured_reviews.name: Anisha Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
​Damage Studio is hands-down one of the best choices if you want high-quality portraiture, event coverage, or specialized creative shoots. Their photography team is incredibly skilled at making you feel comfortable in front of the camera, which completely translates into natural, authentic expressions in the final shots.
​What really sets them apart is their editing and post-production. They have a fantastic ability to enhance photos—whether it's flawless high-fidelity facial retouching, seamless background blurring, or dramatic color grading—without making the subjects look artificial or losing their genuine features. From family portraits to stylized thematic sessions, their commitment to crisp, beautifully composed images is unmatched. Highly professional, creative, and reliable!

featured_reviews.name: Muhammadharis Muhammadhharis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing Damage Studio for our wedding was one of the best decisions we made. The team is extremely professional, creative, and easy to work with. They understand how important every moment is and capture it perfectly.

What we loved the most was their ability to capture real emotions without making anything feel forced. The candid shots were beautiful, and every picture tells a story. The quality of the photos and the cinematic video was top-notch and truly exceeded our expectations.

The entire experience, from shoot to final delivery, felt smooth and well-managed. You can clearly see the effort and passion they put into their work.

If you are searching for a wedding photographer in Mumbai who offers both quality and a cinematic touch, Damage Studio is highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Ansari Amaan
featured_reviews.review_text: If you are looking for a photography team that feels more like family and less like standard vendors, Damage Studio is the one. I am usually super awkward in front of the camera, but the team made me feel completely comfortable from the very first minute.What I absolutely loved about them:Super Chill Vibe: They don't force you into stiff, robotic poses. They let you laugh, talk, and move naturally, which is why their candid shots turn out so incredibly beautiful.Eye for Detail: They managed to capture all the chaotic, emotional, and tiny moments that I didn't even notice happening during the rush of the event.Pure Cinema Quality: When we got our video edits back, my entire family had goosebumps. The music, the transitions, and the colors looked straight out of a movie.Yes, they are a bit of a premium investment, but honestly, for memories that last a lifetime, they are worth every single rupee. A huge thank you to the entire crew for making our days so special!

featured_reviews.name: Bot 1
featured_reviews.review_text:
Damage Studio exceeded every expectation we had for our wedding. From the very first interaction to the final delivery, everything felt premium and professionally handled. The team didn’t just take photos — they created a complete cinematic experience that truly captured the emotions, energy, and beauty of our special day.

Every frame looked elegant, natural, and timeless. The cinematic wedding film felt like a high-end movie, and the attention to detail was simply outstanding. You can clearly see the passion and creativity in their work.

If you are looking for a luxury wedding photographer in Mumbai who can turn your wedding into a beautiful story, Damage Studio is in a league of its own. Absolutely worth it.

featured_reviews.name: Khan Farhan

He was highly professional, very collaborative, and made everyone feel comfortable throughout the event. His ability to capture candid moments and emotions was truly impressive.

Highly recommend Ammar Khan and Damage Studio for anyone looking for quality wedding photography and videography!

featured_reviews.name: Payal Vishal Gholap
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a really good experience with Siddhivinayak Art Photo Studio. From the moment I visited, the team was polite, professional, and very cooperative. They understand exactly what the customer needs and guide you properly throughout the shoot.
The photography quality is impressive—sharp images, good lighting setup, and attention to small details that make a big difference in the final output. Whether it’s portraits, wedding shoots, or special occasions, they manage to capture natural expressions beautifully without making it feel forced.
One thing I really liked is their editing work. The photos are enhanced nicely without over-editing, keeping them natural yet attractive. Skin tones, colors, and background adjustments are handled very well, giving a professional finish to every picture.
The studio also maintains a comfortable environment, which helps you feel relaxed during the shoot. This is especially helpful for people who are not used to facing the camera. The staff makes sure you feel confident, which reflects in the photos.
Talking about pricing, their charges are reasonable compared to the quality of service they provide. You truly get value for your money. Delivery time is also decent—they don’t delay unnecessarily and keep you updated about your work.
Overall, Siddhivinayak Photo Studio is a reliable and trustworthy choice in Mumbai for anyone looking for quality photography services. Whether it’s a small requirement like passport photos or a big event like a wedding, they handle everything with dedication and professionalism.
👉 Highly recommended for great photography, good service, and fair pricing! 👍

featured_reviews.review_text:
It was an absolute pleasure working with Gaurav Doshi as our still photographer. He’s calm, composed, flexible and extremely easy to work with. Our clients were thrilled because he delivered exactly what they were looking for.

We had to fly him in at the very last minute due to major changes in schedule, and Gaurav showed up and delivered – and how! Despite limited manpower, he handled everything smoothly and never let the pressure show.

On top of that, his energy, smile and attitude are the perfect mix of professionalism and genuine warmth. Very happy with the experience and I can’t wait to work with him again. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: r v
featured_reviews.review_text: We have worked with Gaurav for our new collection shoot as a clothing label. Gaurav is  highly professional and enthusiastic about his work. He has given us very good high end shots for our new clothing line . He goes out of the way to help his clients and does enough preparation on the  shoot concept to ensure seamless execution. Overall it was great working with Gaurav and thank you for amazing shots!!

featured_reviews.name: Renuka Sanghvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Gaurav Doshi for a fashion photoshoot, and I am absolutely blown away by the results. His professionalism and artistic approach were truly top-notch. His patience and skill in capturing the perfect fashion moments were impressive. Also, his attention to detail and knack for finding the perfect shot is evident in every photograph he takes. Not only is Gaurav incredibly talented, but he is also professional, friendly, and easy to work with. He has a way of making his subjects feel at ease in front of the camera, which ultimately leads to more natural and beautiful photos.

I would highly recommend Gaurav to anyone looking for stunning, high-quality fashion photography. I am looking forward to working with him again in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Sakina Jaorawala
featured_reviews.review_text: I initially contacted Gaurav for a product photoshoot, and after meeting with him, we decided to collaborate on redesigning the brand identity, starting from the company logo as well as the entire product catalog. Gaurav's attention to detail is exceptional, from crafting the perfect logo to overseeing the photoshoot for the catalog. He carefully considered how each photo would be repurposed for future brand materials. I was so happy with the final result, and it was well received by our customers too. Gaurav truly takes the time to understand the brand and its services, and caters his designs to best represent the brand. We had continuous back and forth to discuss the designing process step by step. He was easy to get in touch with and he truly dedicates his time for the project. He is efficient, thoughtful, and insightful throughout the process. I too learned so much from him throughout the process. It was an absolute pleasure working with Gaurav.

featured_reviews.name: Rudhreesh Kapur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Gaurav makes a very conscious effort to understand the exact requirement and then providing the most creative inputs and solutions. The best part of my shoot experience with him was that he is looking at delivering great value for your time and money. He has a laser focus on delivering high quality and his attention to detail is great. Gaurav is very quick and keeps his word and time commitments. I am very happy with the output delivered by Gaurav and the overall experience deserves full 5 stars.
Highly recommended!
